name: Flexing for Nougat
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
That's an... interesting costume you have on.  Even though you're being nice and helping a sick child trick-or-treat this year, I'm afraid I'm going to have to ask you perform a trick for me!

Let's see... you look so strong and buff in that... costume... let's see you flex!  Yes, go on now and flex for me, strong  man !

When and only when you flex, I'll give you some tasty Orgrimmar Nougat.  It's a great Hallow's End treat.
narrative.objectives: Do a flex emote at Innkeeper Gryshka, and in exchange you'll receive Orgrimmar Nougat!
narrative.offerRewardText:
You are truly mighty, haha! Well done, and thanks for being such a good sport. Here's your candy.

Happy Hallow's End, adventurer!
narrative.requestItemsText: No candy until you flex for me, adventurer...

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 60, 1,650 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Speak with the innkeepers of Orgrimmar, Undercity, and Thunder Bluff, as well as Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village.
